summary: Completed the citation trail for the two retained failed receipts so that every cited observation has an owner in the record. The first harness run for the configuration question (99718ab469974eb1ad40516efe7c999e) is now cited in that account with its event indices and described as a channel failure — its CA_EVENT lines carried no event-name field, six observations were rejected, no comparison was evaluated, and nothing is claimed from it. The earlier live-stall attempt (32cd246ad3824df0b808f51ef1d36182) is cited in the constructor question as an over-specified-admission failure whose admission pinned snapshot and commit indexes that the schedule shifted, leaving every comparison unknown even though its raw events showed the intended behaviour; both are now named alongside the identity-failure receipt 2d92d633d32a4a7c9e204b7dc5c8828b in the joint histories of their accounts. Conclusions, defect judgments and limits are unchanged: the configuration question stays explained with a sourced defect asserted and its consequences bounded by the next membership change or by a state-replacing repair; the constructor question stays explained with the stall now reachable at default batch settings through tolerated snapshot failures; the split-brain and repair questions stay explained with the per-node install and the leader-side restore as the only observed reconciliations, ordinary log comparison argued unavailable from the vote rule, and every remaining limit restated. No further experiment was run: all registered questions are answered with no open necessary gap, and the standing items are limits rather than unanswered questions.
